statement: K64 以未来5步和10步重叠窗口的终点FDE为主要目标，联合优化码本与整条离线标签序列；5/10步使用同一条序列，每步仍为1个运动token、64个运动码字加STOP=0，近直行前进距离间隔至少5cm；K32、RVQ和深圳K256沿用当前版本。
coordinate_system: NWU, metres, yaw rad CCW; local action [forward_m,left_m,ccw_yaw_rad] in current body frame
history: earlier retained nodes only, oldest to newest; skipped frames never re-enter context

rvq.targets: five absolute local poses relative to current actual observation
rvq.padding: repeat real terminal; future_valid_mask excludes padding
rvq.stop: complete [0,0,0] and <apos_1299> occur together iff original terminal; decode complete 000 as zeros(5,3); individual level zero is valid
rvq.projection: positive depth and image frustum only; no occlusion guarantee
rvq.decoded_tiny_step: translation <=0.05 m AND abs(yaw)<=5 deg across actual valid neighbors; exclude whole RVQ trajectory if unresolved

execution: K32/K64 execute one decoded macro target; RVQ execute decoded[0] only, then re-observe and update history; recorded dt is not a fixed control deadline

dataset_fields.history: retained earlier original frame indices and optional RGB images
dataset_fields.recorded_dt_sec: next retained observation time minus current; terminal 0, not a fixed execution deadline

model_registration: map atomic token strings through the actual tokenizer; resize embeddings; numeric codec IDs are not model vocabulary IDs
offline_window_convention: 10 future targets/edges plus original start = 11 observations; length is original raw horizontal arc between retained endpoints; physical wrapped yaw error and unwrapped cumulative drift reported separately
training_principal_check: current configured OSS profile; no separate training-principal credential supplied
offline_joint_evaluation: Full retained generation_pool trajectories evaluated as open-loop ADE/FDE from real start without intermediate ground-truth correction; current code usage and results at report/downloads/JOINT_FULL_METRICS.json. This is codec reconstruction, not policy or robot evaluation.
